goal: Allow external IPC mining clients to submit and prioritize a block over competing tips in a single call
Eliminates extra round trips and race conditions against concurrent chain activations
agreement: Strong support for enabling atomic submission and block prioritization for external miners
Concept approval noting miners rationally prefer their own tips (Sjors, 0xB10C, ViniciusCestarii)
Concept approval for eliminating separate preciousblock RPC round trips (pablomartin4btc)
Resolved objection: inconsistent return status when submitting duplicate precious blocks (Sjors)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because external IPC miners can submit and prioritize a block atomically instead of in separate calls
Eliminates race conditions against competing tips and extra round trips when preferring mined blocks
